Callout.Name: Area Surveillance
Callout.Message: Request for surveillance of an area after repeated reports.
Callout.Advisory: No crime in progress, several complaints logged.

Script.Line: It happens most nights about this time.
They come in a dark car and they are gone in ten minutes.
I am not standing at my window while you are parked on my road.

Lines.Approach: Nothing to attend as such - show yourself in the area and see what is going on.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
